dependency_missing: retain registered ID with null point/SE/bounds and NOT_ESTIMABLE_DEPENDENCY
point_estimate: original unresampled 2235 people, equal weight per person; seed mean is arithmetic mean of paired fit-specific endpoints

randomness.group_draw: For each replicate sample exactly 2234 group indices with replacement from integers [0,2234), using one shared stream and the same replicate indices for all arms, seeds, tasks and views. Include every person row of each selected group, with multiplicity.
randomness.replicate_standard_error: sample standard deviation of the 2048 paired replicate contrasts, ddof=1

scope: approximate full-K simultaneous development inference conditional on models/readers and reused people; not fresh confirmation
